info.name: eve-pdpa webhook
info.description: The four routes of the webhook, signed by the collection pre-request script as API.md describes. Set baseUrl, pdpaSecret and pdpaResolveSecret in an environment (eve-pdpa-webhook.postman_environment.json is a template), never in the collection. Synthetic data only.

exec: // Signs every request the way API.md describes: HMAC-SHA256 over
// `${timestamp}.${scope}.${body}`, the scope taken from the route.
if (!scope) throw new Error("no signature scope for /" + route)
if (!secret) throw new Error("set pdpaSecret and pdpaResolveSecret in the environment")
// The body exactly as Postman will send it, variables filled in.
const mac = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(timestamp + "." + scope + "." + body, secret).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex)
// A Vercel preview is behind Deployment Protection: Settings → Deployment
// Protection → Protection Bypass for Automation gives the value.

item.name: Inbound — protect a message and forward it

request.description: Set forwardTo to a destination you control. The answer says processed or blocked; the protected text, with [tok:…] tokens, arrives at forwardTo.

body.raw:
{
  "policy": "otp",
  "sessionId": "conv_8f2a",
  "ref": "msg_10293",
  "text": "เบอร์ 091-888-7777 ค่ะ",
  "context": "ขอเบอร์ติดต่อค่ะ",
  "forwardTo": "https://ai.example.com/inbound",
  "replyTo": "https://chat.example.com/reply"
}

request.description: Send the policy, sessionId and replyTo that came with the forwarded message.

body.raw:
{
  "policy": "otp",
  "sessionId": "conv_8f2a",
  "ref": "msg_10294",
  "text": "ส่ง OTP ไปที่ [tok:rfdbkfrtnsmbvpsh] แล้วค่ะ",
  "replyTo": "https://chat.example.com/reply"
}

request.description: Signed with pdpaResolveSecret. Put a token from a forwarded message in token; the example token answers ok: false, not_found.
